need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts. The case: organized group to block construction site, causing stoppage, economic loss, social impact. Likely charges: "聚众扰乱公共场所秩序、交通秩序" or "聚众扰乱社会秩序" or "聚众扰乱公共秩序". In Chinese criminal law, there is crime of "聚众扰乱公共场所秩序" (Article 293). Also "聚众扰乱交通秩序" maybe not. The facts: they blocked construction site, causing economic loss. Could be "聚众扰乱公共场所秩序" (public place). Also possibly "非法集会、游行、示威罪"? But Chinese law: "聚众扰乱公共场所秩序罪" (Article 293). Also maybe "非法占用土地" but they didn't occupy, they blocked. Could be "破坏生产经营" (Article 275) - sabotage? They prevented construction, causing economic loss. The crime of "破坏生产经营" includes obstructing production, causing loss. However typical charge: "聚众扰乱公共场所秩序" is used in many examples above for similar. In earlier examples, they used "聚众扰乱公共场所秩序、交通秩序" for protests causing conflict. So likely this case: "聚众扰乱公共场所秩序". Also maybe "非法集会、游行、示威罪" but not in list.

Thus answer: [罪名]聚众扰乱公共场所秩序<eoa>

Check if any other charges: "非法占用林地" no. "非法占用农用地" no. "非法持有枪支" no. So single charge.
